morphology.source: Compact connected three-panel/faceted white form with a pale blue border/glow; an upper-left broad polygon joins a tall narrow right polygon and a lower polygon separated by dark bevel seams. It has no central ring, holes, organic spines, or screen rectangle.
morphology.visibleDiscriminatingFeature: Autodestruction has three detached rounded lobes arranged around a conspicuous central ring; the source is one connected beveled tri-panel form with no ring.

candidateVerdicts.visibleFeature: Three detached rounded lobes plus central ring are absent from the source.
The lander has a tall central spire and wide upturned side wings; the source is a compact asymmetrical faceted cluster.
The intruder is an organic curled silhouette with head perforations, dorsal spines, and a tail; none appear in the source.
The robot is a broad head shape with two circular eye holes and a top tab; the source has no holes or bilateral face outline.
The computer is a rectangular screen/terminal silhouette; the source is a three-panel beveled form.

conclusion: No compared canonical glossary token matches. Preserve the source mark as a literal bespoke white-and-blue faceted tri-panel/corner emblem; do not assign a semantic token.
